source_refs.note: Topic 9.4.4 with the class activity (PDF 217, printed 214). The e-commerce box is printed inside 9.5.1 and carried here. Long question 5 is answered.

blocks.text: Successful businesses understand customers' needs. A water-purifier seller in Karachi might stress clean drinking water during hot summers. A Lahore start-up selling handmade jewellery online shows products on Instagram and Facebook, works with local influencers and offers limited-time wedding-season discounts to grow sales. The book adds that e-commerce in Pakistan is growing fast, so businesses that market well online reach a much wider audience.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: develop a marketing and sales strategy for a product you choose. What are its essential components, and how would you tailor them to different markets (long question 5)?
blocks.explanation: Components: a target market and its needs, a clear brand and message, channels to reach customers, pricing, sales tactics such as discounts and promotions, customer service, and a way to measure results. Tailoring: young urban buyers may be reached through Instagram and influencers with online discounts; rural or older buyers through local shops, radio or word of mouth; festive seasons such as Eid and weddings call for special offers.

items: Know customers' needs and meet them through the right channels and offers (online jewellery start-up).
